reason: 5.17.3 theme tokens honour opacity modifiers. Token colours resolved to plain var(--color-*) strings, which Tailwind cannot apply an opacity modifier to, so every token class written with one compiled to zero CSS - 96 rules across 85 files that never rendered, including keyboard focus rings (which fell back to Tailwind's default blue) and every semantic status border. Fixed in tailwind.config.js by making the token colours function-valued; borderColor and backgroundColor also gained the single-prefix status aliases textColor already had. No callsite changes, no Node/Python SDK surface change.
